description: Rebuild temporal_stability enrichment module to fix weak signal plateau (currently 3 distinct values). Current version temporal_stability_enrichment_v3.py produces narrow range (40.0-90.0) with low discrimination. MUST read MULTIPLE metadata fields including age_days, first_seen, last_updated, commit_frequency, release_regularity, and publisher_verified to produce granular scores. Enrichment contract: pure function compute_score(metadata: dict) -> tuple[float, dict], no DB writes, no network. Must yield at least 20 distinct score values.
